description: This PHP source file defines the EditJobVacancyController class, which is a controller responsible for handling the editing of job vacancy entries in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. The class extends an abstract Vue controller, indicating it interacts with a Vue.js front-end component. It sets up properties for the front-end component such as vacancy ID, allowed file types, and maximum file size during the pre-render phase.
